name: switch
title: Switch
description: A switch whose thumb squashes on press, springs across the track, and can rotate icons in and out.

useCases: Settings that apply immediately, such as notifications or dark mode, with optional icons for the two states.
limitations: One size, 44 by 24 pixels. Thumb icons should be small glyphs about 12 pixels across.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors. Supply label or aria-label. Controlled usage requires updating checked in onCheckedChange. Reduced motion removes the squash and moves the thumb instantly.

docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/switch.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.
